title: Laser kidney stone treatment (ureteroscopy)
what: Working through the urethra, the surgeon guides a thin tube with a camera to the stone and breaks it up with a laser. There are no cuts in the skin.
why: When a stone in the ureter or kidney will not pass on its own, causes pain, or blocks urine flow.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 90 minutes, with 1 to 3 days in hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you have a fever or a urine infection

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood and urine tests, and a kidney ultrasound or CT scan. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Usually general or spinal anesthesia. The anesthetist will discuss the options with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Things to pack
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes, slippers, a charger, and your daily medicines.

bring: Your referral and CT or ultrasound images
Documents and a list of your medicines
Things for a 1 to 3 day hospital stay
steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
The surgeon passes a thin instrument with a camera through the urethra
The stone is found and broken up with a laser
The pieces are removed, or will pass in your urine
Often a temporary tube called a stent is placed from the kidney to the bladder
feel: Burning and frequent urges in the first days
A little blood in the urine
With a stent, an ache in your side when you pee
after: Drink plenty of water, unless your doctor says otherwise
The stent is removed at a time your doctor sets. Do not miss it
Small stones may pass in your urine. Sometimes you are asked to collect them for testing
Your doctor will advise you on diet to prevent new stones
red_flags: Severe side pain that painkillers do not ease
Urine is bright red or has clots

faq.q: Can I forget about the stent?
faq.a: No. The stent must be removed on the date your doctor gives. Write it down.
Sometimes. Your doctor may test the stone and give advice on food and drinking.

reminders.text: Kidney stone treatment tomorrow. Pack your scans, documents, and things. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
